label: <DEL> step of the longest (L=9) sequences
explanation: Fires only on the delimiter step (in_tok <DEL>, recall_idx 0); essentially never in the original or copy phases (7 of 12828 dev activations). Length-gated: about 65% of L=9 delimiter steps fire (90% of activation mass), about 13% of L=8 delimiter steps fire at lower magnitude (10% of mass), and it never fires for L<=7. Within L=9, whether it fires and how strongly depends weakly and diffusely on content: rates rise with digit count (n_digits) and with certain first tokens / tokens about to be output (1, o, 0, z, c, f), and sequences containing t or o fire more often. No simple content rule separates firing from non-firing L=9 delimiter steps, so precision is limited to about 0.65.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: 1, o, c, 0, f, z; least: t, e, s, g) and the third original token (most: x, t, o, e, 3, c; least: p, s, f, b); timing cues that raise it most: L=9 & t=9, to_go=8, t=9.
